market_summary: Late New York session trading shows broad consolidation across precious metals, FX majors, and crypto following earlier impulsive selloffs. All assets are trading below their respective session VWAP and Value Area Lows, but volume has dried up (RVOL below 2.0 everywhere) with prices drifting mid-channel or into established session low supports. Gold is constrained by positive gamma dampening and call walls, while delta divergences in FX highlight absorption rather than trend continuation. High discipline dictates a HOLD stance across all five assets.

signals.rationale: In NEW_YORK_SESSION, XAUUSD trades below VAL (3881.94) and POC (3978.13), testing VAL from below. CVD is BEARISH (-6.32) though cvd_slope (+0.64) is slightly fading. Price is below descending VWAP (3929.64) and downward-sloping EMA50 (3908.47), compressing along EMA20 (3883.80). Candles sit mid-channel between lower ATR band (3866.01) and upper ATR band (3901.58). Volume is sub-par with RVOL at 0.808 (grey bar, no yellow expansion spike). GEX is in POSITIVE_DAMPENING regime above Gamma Flip (3868.05), with Call Wall #2 at 3887.38 capping immediate upside while Session Low support sits at 3852.35. Due to positive gamma dampening and lack of volume, action is HOLD.
signals.level_event: rejection at EMA20 and Call Wall #2
